independent_ROOT_SQL:
WITH scope AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(properties_json,'$.specNumber') AS specNumber FROM _node_record
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(_node_record.labels_json) WHERE value='Spec')
 AND json_extract(properties_json,'$.specNumber') IN ('38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291')
 ), paths AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT a.node_id agr, json_extract(s.properties_json,'$.specNumber') specNumber
 FROM _node_record a JOIN edge e ON e.src_id=a.node_id AND e.rel_type='REFERENCES'
 JOIN _node_record cr ON cr.node_id=e.dst_id
 JOIN edge m ON m.src_id=cr.node_id AND m.rel_type='MODIFIES'
 JOIN _node_record s ON s.node_id=m.dst_id
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(a.labels_json) WHERE value='Agreement')
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(cr.labels_json) WHERE value='CR')
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.labels_json) WHERE value='Spec')
 )
 SELECT scope.specNumber, count(DISTINCT paths.agr) agrCount
 FROM scope LEFT JOIN paths ON scope.specNumber=paths.specNumber
 GROUP BY scope.specNumber ORDER BY agrCount DESC,scope.specNumber ASC
